subject: Fix undefined behavior warning in UBSAN (#1709)
reason: The change only replaces casts of sdsfree to void(*)(void*) with the equivalent sdsfreeVoid wrapper in evalInit and ldbInit, to silence a UBSAN incompatible-function-pointer-type warning. The wrapper simply calls sdsfree, so the list free behavior is byte-for-byte identical; no command reply, data handling, replication, or persistence behavior changes, and no observable difference exists between the builds to test.
